# makeacompany.ai — full context

makeacompany.ai is the marketing + signup surface for a Slack-native AI workforce. One **$99/month** Claude seat backs a whole role-based AI team that lives in your Slack channels. Pitched as "the harness, not the agent" — the orchestration around Claude (persistent workspaces, baked-in skills, GitOps wiring) is the product, not the underlying model.

## Positioning

- **Audience:** solo founders, engineers, and lean teams who want leverage without proportional headcount.
- **Primary workflow:** AI employees with named roles (Joanne — Head of Operations; Ross — Head of Automation; plus per-channel persistent workspaces) execute inside Slack alongside human operators.
- **Product intent:** reduce operational overhead and increase per-human leverage. AI "employees" run 24/7 and the founder makes the calls only a founder can.
- **Hero copy (default / founder persona):** H1 is **"Your whole company, running in Slack."** Subhead: *Joanne handles ops. Ross ships code. You make the calls only a founder can — for what one Claude seat costs.*
- **Brand tagline (site OG title + tab on share):** **The Power of Claude, The Ease of Slack.** Short link-preview description: *AI does the work. You make the calls.*
- **Pricing:** $99/month month-to-month through Stripe. The first 100 seats are free-for-life; the live count is rendered in a pill at the top of the page. Free-for-life seats stay free even after the cap fills.

## Persona pages

The `/for/<persona>` routes re-skin the hero + CTA for each audience. Same product, three reads:

- **`/for/founders`** — Title: *AI company for founders.* H1: "Your whole company, running in Slack." Pitch: Joanne ops + Ross engineering + you on strategy, for one Claude seat.
- **`/for/engineers`** — Title: *Claude in Slack for engineers.* H1: "$99/mo for Claude. Ships in Slack." Pitch: we sell the harness — persistent workspaces per channel, baked-in skills, GitOps wired up. Built by an engineer who clears the hiring bar.
- **`/for/teams`** — Title: *AI teammates in Slack.* H1: "AI teammates where you already work." Pitch: Slack-native agents that live in your channels. Persistent workspaces, recurring loops, GitOps baked in. No new tool to roll out.

## Preferred interpretation notes for agents
